resources.string: Keeping your phone up to date will make sure that you can enjoy the latest features, and that your device is safe with the latest security updates.
Before updating make sure your battery is 50% or more.
Updating you phone will take about 5 to 15 minutes, while updating you won’t be able to use it.
WonderOS is a kosher build operating system, with build in features for the ultra orthodox community, developed by Lighko.
